purpose: Conservative research rubric mapping prompt-side risk tags to preflight interventions. Not validated product logic.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt asks the model to coordinate many people, products, props, or background entities in one clip.
rules.notes: Hypothesis-heavy. Do not block on this tag alone.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt chains several simultaneous or sequential actions into one generation.
rules.notes: Stronger when actions include body mechanics, transformations, or physics.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt depends on orbit, pan, tracking, dolly, zoom, handheld, or 360-degree movement.
rules.notes: Workflow-supported, not a broad model benchmark.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt requires stable character, face, costume, or identity without reference assets.
rules.notes: Pause when identity continuity is central and no reference exists.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt requires stable product shape, material, color, logo placement, or package details without locked attributes.
Prompt contains incompatible style, camera, subject, lighting, motion, or realism requirements.
rules.notes: Hypothesis-heavy and not directly evidenced in the current evidence log.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt compresses a multi-beat story, multiple scene changes, or a long temporal arc into one clip.
rules.notes: Use when the prompt reads like a sequence rather than a single shot.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt lacks a single-shot boundary when it describes a sequence, multiple locations, or multiple camera setups.
rules.notes: Treatment should produce shot-level prompts before generation.

rules.detection_hint: Requested task appears poorly matched to selected model or mode.
rules.notes: Weak direct evidence. Use as a routing/checklist prompt until generation trials exist.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt expects more action, continuity, or story than the requested duration can likely support.
rules.notes: Hypothesis-heavy and not directly evidenced. Do not block unless paired with stronger supported risks.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt depends on complex body mechanics, physics, fluid motion, splashes, machinery, or precise action accuracy.
rules.notes: Keep action simple or isolate it in one constrained shot.

rules.detection_hint: Prompt requires legible text, exact typography, logos, barcodes, signage, or brand marks inside generated video.
rules.notes: Weak evidence. Do not overstate until direct generation trials exist.
